commands.command: set -euo pipefail; SHA=72e1a51f98e7b2b6c2229175b18b5dcd928bd7d6; LA="$HOME/local-agent"; cd "$LA"; git fetch --quiet origin main; test "$(git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD)" = main; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SHA"; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$SHA"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; echo LOCAL_AGENT_HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); if git show-ref --verify --quiet refs/tags/v4.11.1; then test "$(git rev-list -n1 v4.11.1)" = "$SHA"; else git tag -a v4.11.1 "$SHA" -m 'local-agent v4.11.1'; fi; git push origin refs/tags/v4.11.1; for b in v4.11.1-control-probe-staging v4.11.1-logging-staging v4.11.1-macos-metadata-staging; do if git ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git push origin --delete "$b"; fi; done; for p in "$HOME/local-agent-v4.11.1-control-probe-staging" "$HOME/local-agent-v4.11.1-logging-staging" "$HOME/local-agent-v4.11.1-macos-metadata-staging"; do if git worktree list --porcelain | grep -Fxq "worktree $p"; then git worktree remove --force "$p"; fi; done; git worktree prune; for b in v4.11.1-control-probe-staging v4.11.1-logging-staging v4.11.1-macos-metadata-staging; do git branch -D "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; done; GB="$HOME/agent-workspace/repos/growbox-ml-controller/control"; test -d "$GB"; for b in _noop_gs_temp _noop_should_not_exist; do if git -C "$GB" ls-remote --exit-code --heads origin "$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then git -C "$GB" push origin --delete "$b"; fi; done; echo TAG_COMMIT=$(git rev-list -n1 v4.11.1); git ls-remote --tags origin refs/tags/v4.11.1 'refs/tags/v4.11.1^{}'; echo WORKTREES; git worktree list; echo FINAL_STATUS; git status --short
